description: This file declares a function to create a new command handler for bug report commands within the Cuttlefish project's host commands, specifically related to CVD (Cuttlefish Virtual Device). It includes header dependencies and is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: NewCvdBugreportCommandHandler
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler configured for 'bugreport' commands, utilizing the provided InstanceManager.
